title: Guitar Hero II 2 (Sony PlayStation 2, 2006) Black Label PS2 Complete w/ Manual
descriptionText: The product is Guitar Hero II 2 for the Sony PlayStation 2, released in 2006. It is rated T for Teen and includes the manual. Published by Activision Classics, this black label version of the game offers an immersive experience for players who enjoy rhythm-based gameplay. With the game's unique gameplay and iconic Guitar Hero controllers, players can simulate playing the guitar by using a special controller or by singing along to lyrics in rhythm games.
